fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.
As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About fal
fal is the generative media platform for developers. We give the world's most ambitious AI teams the fastest way to run image, video, audio and 3D models in production. We also provide the GPU infrastructure they need to train, fine-tune and serve models of their own.
Our inference engine was built from the ground up for generative media. It has made fal the platform builders reach for when speed, scale and reliability matter. Our customers range from the fastest-growing AI companies in the world to the Fortune 500. More and more of them are coming to us for raw compute as well as inference and model APIs.
We're a small, high-output team, and we're growing fast. If you want to be in the room while the infrastructure layer of generative AI gets built, this is that room.

About the Role
As an Account Executive on our Compute team, you'll own new-logo acquisition across AI-native startups and neolabs. You'll sell fal's full compute offering: dedicated GPU clusters, reserved and on-demand capacity, and the inference platform that developers already build on. This is a pure hunter role. You won't inherit a book. You'll build one, and with it you'll help define how fal takes compute to market.

What You'll Do
Build and own your pipeline
• 
Own all net-new logo acquisition across a defined set of AI-native startups, neolabs and research-driven model builders.
• 
Build pipeline from scratch through founder and investor networks, targeted outbound, community and events, and the market signals that tell you a team is about to need compute: a fresh fundraise, a new model release, a hiring spree in research.
• 
Use fal's product data to spot developers and teams already building on our platform whose usage shows they're ready for a larger compute commitment.
• 
Keep a focused, prioritized target list. Know which 30 companies matter most this quarter and why.
Lead technical, consultative sales cycles
• 
Engage founders, CTOs, heads of research and infrastructure leads early, often before a formal buying process exists.
• 
Run deep discovery on each customer's workloads: training vs. fine-tuning vs. inference, model architecture and scale, GPU generation and cluster topology, storage and networking, utilization targets and timeline.
• 
Partner with Solutions Engineering on benchmarks, proofs of concept and architecture reviews that show fal's performance and reliability on the customer's own workloads.
• 
Translate technical requirements into a clear business case: time-to-cluster, price-performance, flexibility and total cost.
Structure and close compute deals
• 
Design commercial agreements that fit how fast-growing AI companies actually operate: reserved clusters, on-demand and burst capacity, prepaid commitments, and blended platform agreements.
• 
Work with our capacity, finance and deal desk teams to secure supply and structure deals that work for both the customer and fal.
• 
Run the full cycle from first conversation through negotiation and signature, keeping momentum through commercial, technical and legal review.
Grow with your customers
• 
Land with an initial workload, then expand as customers scale from experimentation to large training runs to production inference.
• 
Build multi-threaded relationships so fal is the first call when a customer's next capacity need appears.
• 
Hand off smoothly and stay aligned with Account Management and Customer Success as accounts mature.
Shape the business
• 
Bring structured customer and market feedback to Product, Infrastructure and Leadership: what's winning, what's missing, and what competitors are doing.
• 
Help build the playbook. You'll be among the first sellers dedicated to this segment, and your input will shape how the motion scales.
• 
Keep forecasting accurate and pipeline up to date in Salesforce.

Qualifications/Nice to Have:
• 
5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience, with a consistent record of meeting or beating quota in a closing role.
• 
2+ years selling cloud infrastructure, GPU compute, AI/ML platforms or developer tools. You've sold technical products to technical buyers and you're fluent in the conversation.
• 
Startup and AI-native buyers are your home turf. You understand how funding cycles, runway and competitive pressure drive buying, and you know how to move at their pace.
• 
Technical credibility. You can hold a real conversation with an ML engineer or research lead about GPU generations, interconnect, cluster sizing, training vs. inference economics, and why utilization matters. You don't need to be an engineer, but engineers should be glad you're on the call.
• 
A builder's approach to pipeline. You've generated a large share of your own pipeline and you're energized, not intimidated, by a blank territory.
• 
Strong commercial judgment. You know when a long-term reservation is the right answer for a customer and when flexibility matters more. You structure deals that set customers up to grow.
• 
Low ego, high ownership. You collaborate closely with Solutions Engineering, Product and Finance, and you take accountability for outcomes.
• 
Experience at a GPU cloud, neocloud, hyperscaler startup team, or AI infrastructure company
• 
Existing relationships across the AI startup, research and venture capital ecosystem
• 
Experience with usage- or consumption-based business models
• 
A track record of turning self-serve or product-led adoption into larger committed contracts
• 
Familiarity with generative media (image, video, audio, 3D) or foundation model development
• 
Familiarity with structured sales methods such as MEDDPICC

What we offer at fal
• 
Interesting and challenging work
• 
A lot of learning and growth opportunities
• 
We offer visa sponsorship and will help you relocate to San Francisco.
• 
Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)
• 
Regular team events and offsites

5f57b7fc22acbd4b.description:
About PostHog
PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.
We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:
• 
A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics, replay vision, AI observability, and error tracking
• 
PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data
• 
Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.
We are:
• 
Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.
• 
Default alive. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.
• 
Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.
We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible. 
 
Things we care about
• 
Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.
• 
Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.
• 
Shipping fast: Why not now? We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.
• 
Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.
• 
Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.

Why this role at PostHog now?
We have a strong brand and a lot of strong content for you to build on. What we don't have (yet) is someone whose whole job is making it move.
You'll be PostHog's first in-house video animator, and the creative engine behind everything that moves in our visuals.
We take video seriously (although we’re not really so serious). Our Video team ships documentaries, product launches, ads, social shorts, and more.
Right now, there’s no single owner of motion at PostHog, so the effort comes from several people, each with their own style, and most animation gets added at the very end of post-production. It doesn't move like one brand.
Your job will be to give it one. You'll be the creative engine behind PostHog's animated visuals. Your fingerprints will be on how PostHog moves, everywhere, but primarily in video.
This isn't a pure motion graphics role. We need someone who can also draw. You'll eventually design and illustrate your own assets as well as animate them, and sometimes you might even ship illustrations that never move at all.
Simply put, you care about the craft, have opinions about what makes animation great, and have a showreel that proves it.

What you’ll be doing
The work spans product launches, feature trailers, changelogs, social shorts, minidocs, animated ads, GIFs on our website, and even icons inside the PostHog app. One day you might be working out how the hedgehog walks; the next, rebuilding our UI in 3D for a launch.
Styles range from clean motion graphics to fully illustrated, character-led animation. If your showreel only has one style in it, this probably isn't the role for you.
We expect you to be:
• 
Defining how PostHog moves. You'll shape our motion and animation language more or less from scratch, and you'll bring strong opinions about it to the table.
• 
Bringing the hedgehog to life. Our beloved mascot is a 2D, static hedgehog. You'll illustrate and animate it, and work out how it walks, reacts, and shows its personality in motion.
• 
Being the go-to person for motion in video. Documentaries, product launches, screen-recorded tutorials, changelogs, social short-form. Sometimes you'll work hand in hand with Alex (Video Producer) and Lottie (Graphics Lead); other times you'll take an animation-only piece from idea and script all the way to delivery on your own.
• 
Making our product look good in motion. Recreating and reimagining the PostHog UI in 3D space for "screenshare-plus" visuals, and animating icons that live inside the app itself.
• 
Building the toolkit. Animated logos, brand elements, lower thirds, transitions, and motion templates that make every future video faster to produce.
• 
Working beyond video. Motion for ads and campaigns, GIFs and animated icons for the website, and pure illustration work alongside our Graphics team.
Example public projects
• 
PopQuiz
• 
Changelog (in different styles)
• 
Hackathon documentary
• 
Small Teams
• 
PostHog in Slack
• 
Eggplant animation

What you won't be doing
❌ Executing someone else's storyboard frame by frame. You'll get briefs, not blueprints, and we'll expect you to have ideas of your own.
❌ Cutting full videos. We have editors for that. Knowing your way around an edit helps, but it isn't the job.
❌ Picking one house style and never leaving it.
❌ Making corporate explainers where a flat-shaded person waves at a laptop.

You’ll fit right in if:
• 
You’re advanced in After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop. Fresco is a bonus.
• 
You have a strong portfolio demonstrating technical excellence, a clear creative point of view, and a wide variety of styles (motion graphics, illustration-led animation, character work).
• 
You have illustrated / designed and animated motion graphics. You design and draw your own assets rather than only waiting for someone to hand you files to move.
• 
You originate ideas. You've taken work from concept to delivery: come up with the idea, written the script or voiceover, then animated it.
• 
You’re a highly creative artist with strong personal standards for quality. You care about the craft.
• 
You have a strong opinion about what the best animated film of all time is, and are able to defend your decision to the death. (It's either The Incredibles or Coco.)
Nice to have
• 
You have created content for developer communities or technical audiences.
• 
Basic video editing. Enough to rough out how your animation sits in the cut.
• 
You have translated product UI / UX into animated assets.
If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you - we're happy to accommodate!

5f045c2f2e2877e6.description: ### **About the Role** We're building the future of education and are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is comfortable navigating ambiguity. We run a consumer app that delivers short-form videos and bite-sized revision content for exam preparation — built for aspirants who study on a phone, in short bursts, largely across Tier 2/3 India. You won't just be pulling reports; you'll be the person who answers "what is actually happening in our app, and what should we do about it?" Ideally, you are someone who can take a vague question, turn it into a measurable one, and come back with an answer the team can act on the same week. ### **What You'll Do** - **Instrumentation & Data Quality:** Audit our Mixpanel event taxonomy — what's tracked, what's broken, what's double-counted, what's missing. Work with engineers to fix the tracking plan. - **Funnel Ownership:** Own the activation funnel end to end — install → first app open → login/signup → first content view → first completed video → habit. Break each step down by source, device, geo, cohort and exam category. Find the drops, size them in users and in rupees, and tell us where to fix first. - **Notifications & Lifecycle:** Own notification opt-in, delivery, open rate and downstream session quality — by segment, by time of day, by message type. Tell us who to send what and when, then prove it with a test rather than a hunch. - **ETL & Data Plumbing:** Pull raw event data out of Mixpanel, join it with backend/Postgres data, campaign data and content metadata. Build clean, reusable datasets so recurring questions take minutes, not days. - **Feature Measurement:** For everything we ship — define the success metric and the guardrail metric before launch, read the result honestly after, including when it's flat or negative. Recommend what to double down on and what to kill. - **Retention & Content Analytics:** D1/D7/D30 retention curves, cohort behaviour, session depth, completion rate per video, and which formats, topics and lengths actually bring users back. - **End-to-End Ownership:** Close the loop with a short weekly written view — what moved, why, what we do next week. Two pages, no fluff. An insight nobody reads is worth zero. ### **Metrics You'll Live Inside** - First app open - Login / signup conversion - Notification opt-in, delivery, CTR - Activation rate · D1 / D7 / D30 retention · DAU / WAU / MAU and stickiness - Session length and sessions per user · Content completion rate - Funnel drop-off by step - CAC and channel quality ### **What You Bring** - **Real Consumer Exposure:** Hands-on work with a consumer/D2C mobile app's numbers — via an internship, a startup, a growth team or a serious side project. You've seen real user data at real volume, not a Kaggle CSV. - **Product Analytics:** Working knowledge of **Mixpanel** (strongly preferred), or Amplitude, CleverTap, MoEngage, Firebase or GA4. - **SQL:** Joins, CTEs, window functions, cohort and funnel queries against **PostgreSQL**. - **Tooling:** Excel/Google Sheets at a serious level, and **Python (pandas)** for anything Sheets can't handle. - **Metric Judgement:** You understand what a number *means*, not just how to compute it. About Us 
Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.  
Today, 20 million+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.   
We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way.  
Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
And this is just the beginning!
 
What’s the role?  
As an Associate Product Manager at Nek by Jar, you will own the platform and internal systems that power Nek’s day-to-day operations. This includes our internal Order Management / CRM tools and key third-party integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other operational partners.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, and external partners to improve these systems, resolve gaps, and support new product initiatives. You will also be expected to build a strong understanding of Nek’s overall architecture, services, integrations, and data flows so that you can evaluate the impact of new features across the platform.
 
What will be your responsibilities?
 
• Platform & Internal Tools
• Own Nek’s internal Order Management / CRM platform and other operational tools used by Customer Support and Operations teams.
• Identify product and process gaps and drive improvements that make internal systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.
• Understand the end-to-end order lifecycle across inventory, payments, logistics, communication, and post-order journeys.
• Integrations & Architecture
• Act as the Product POC for integrations such as Unicommerce, Shiprocket, Delhivery, and other logistics or operational partners.
• Own integration requirements, feature enablement, partner coordination, and issue resolution.
• Develop a working understanding of APIs, services, dependencies, data flows, failure scenarios, and reconciliation across the platform.
• Evaluate and onboard new third-party platforms as business requirements evolve. 
• Data & Experimentation
• Use product and operational data to identify problems, validate hypotheses, and prioritise opportunities.
• Analyse funnels, user behaviour, operational metrics, and feature performance using tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, SQL, and dashboards.
• Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, define success metrics, and recommend whether initiatives should be scaled, iterated, or stopped. 
• Execution
• Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, Data, Design, and Business teams to take initiatives from problem identification to launch.
• Translate business and operational problems into clear product requirements and scalable solutions.
• Monitor outcomes after launch and drive subsequent improvements. 
What’s required from you?
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline from a reputed institute.
• 1–3 years of experience in Product, Growth, Product Analytics, or a similar role in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
• Strong analytical skills and hands-on familiarity with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Clevertap, SQL, or similar platforms.
• Good understanding of A/B testing, funnels, metrics, and data-driven product decision-making.
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to prioritise effectively and work across multiple teams in a fast-paced environment.
• Prior experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, D2C, or order/logistics-heavy products is preferred. 
What do we stand for? 
 
The five values that we live by : 
Passion: At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work. 
Equality: We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves. 
Growth: When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact. 
Accountability: The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions. 
Consistency: We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time. 
Join us and let’s build something amazing together!
